metric_definitions.pair_dependence: Overlapping seed pairs are dependent descriptive comparisons, not independent trials or a confidence sample.
metric_definitions.leading_primary_tie: Number of sampled actions, including the chosen action, whose primary mean or visit key equals its leading key exactly.
metric_definitions.complete_tie: Number of sampled actions, including the chosen action, whose mean and visits both equal its leading keys exactly. Captured encounter order resolves the tie.
metric_definitions.gaps: Exact binary-float mean difference and integer visit difference between leading two rows in each ranking; null if fewer than two sampled actions.
metric_definitions.coverage: Only selected early-state sensitivity, not late-round, prior, parallel, other-horizon or policy-quality generalization.

question: How do independent-seed final-action recommendations vary under fixed work, when comparing mean/visits with visits/mean and half/current/double exploration?
state_rationale: Three existing supported encounter shapes: one target, multiple targets and registered boss rules. Initial pre-action states use two preselected environment seeds, changing dealt physical hand slots and legal branching without constructing a new domain. Inputs were captured with one-round, one-simulation bootstrap recording before deciding search; the selected initial boundary precedes that search.
control_rationale: Half/current/double coefficient in the unchanged shaped-reward scale measures local sensitivity without claiming an optimum. The maximum existing saved-state consumer allowance of64 simulations permits all admitted initial actions to receive opportunities while keeping a small fixed budget. Horizon4 matches that consumer default. No simulation/horizon tuning occurs.

selectors.baseline: mean_shaped_reward descending, visits descending, captured root encounter order for complete ties
selectors.alternative: visits descending, mean_shaped_reward descending, same captured root encounter order for complete ties

comparison: Both selectors use the same captured root statistics; changed exploration reruns search. Matching seeds across coefficients do not imply identical trajectories. All virtual visit counts are zero. Root-parallel aggregation is excluded; its weighted sufficient-statistic/canonical tie contract is documented but not experimentally generalized.
metrics: per-state/per-coefficient selected-action frequencies for both rules
top two mean and visit gaps in their own ranking
matched-seed changed-coefficient action disagreement, not identical-trajectory inference
source, input/state identities and complete raw root visits/value sums in encounter order
ordering: Exploratory inputs first, then untouched confirmatory inputs. Within each input, listed coefficient order then ascending listed seeds. Confirmatory results remain unexamined until the collector/metrics and any exploratory source-contract fixes are frozen. No exploratory tuning or pruning is planned.
failures: Retain every declared input/seed/coefficient cell. A raised exception or interrupted/over-budget/inconsistent search is an incomplete cell, not a decision. Stop the deciding batch on the first such contract failure, preserve completed cells and its partial receipt; investigate explicitly rather than retrying stochastic cells for favorable outcomes. No values are imputed and no unfavorable cell is removed.
stopping: Finish exactly the predeclared cells, unless a recorded contract/host/user boundary interrupts. External runner90-second direct-process bound is a safety stop, not an algorithm deadline. No child processes or competing owned experiments are launched.
disposition: Unless an independent applicable quality evaluation is separately qualified and executed, preserve the engine/default final rule and coefficient. A descriptive result delivers a reproducible stability diagnostic connected to ordinary decision reports and the existing companion. No stability, sampled mean, selector majority or literature theorem alone establishes stronger decisions, calibrated correctness probability or optimality.
protected: Reward, simulator/actions, engine-only packaging, managed policy, historical record identity/admission, zero-search replay, passive inspection, old default decision interface/output contract and reader kit meanings.
